diga_page.title: Accelerating Your DiGA Fast-Track Success
diga_page.author: QODEVS Engineering Advisory
diga_page.s1_text: Navigating the German DiGA (Digitale Gesundheitsanwendung) framework requires more than just clinical knowledge; it demands rigorous software architecture. At QODEVS, we engineer your digital therapeutics to strictly comply with BfArM requirements from day one, ensuring a seamless transition to statutory health insurance reimbursement.
diga_page.s2_text: We eliminate technical friction and guide you through every organizational gate with precision:
diga_page.m1_text: We handle the complete ISO 13485 lifecycle and technical documentation, engineering your software to guarantee Class I or IIa compliance.
diga_page.m2_text: Our team implements state-of-the-art DSGVO/GDPR security and FHIR/HL7 interoperability frameworks, ensuring zero technical friction during BfArM evaluation.
diga_page.m3_text: We build robust data telemetry into your application, empowering you to effortlessly prove positive healthcare effects and secure your permanent listing.
diga_page.quote: "Speed to market in digital health is not about cutting corners—it is about designing regulatory compliance into your software architecture from day one."
diga_page.s3_text: We don't just write code; we provide strategic engineering that protects your investment:
diga_page.p1_text: We never retrofit compliance. We build modular, traceable code foundations from sprint zero, saving you months of delays and expensive re-writes.
diga_page.p2_text: We architect systems with zero tolerance for vulnerabilities, ensuring your health data handling aligns perfectly with German statutory criteria.
diga_page.p3_text: We advance technical readiness in tandem with your clinical study design, integrating seamless outcome tracking right from the project kickoff.
